│ ✻ agentcage v{VERSION}                        │

Usage: agentcage [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Defense-in-depth proxy sandbox for AI agents.

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  cage      Manage cages.
  doctor    Check system health and diagnose common issues.
  domain    Manage cage domain filters.
  init      Scaffold a new agentcage config file.
  scaffold  Create and manage custom scaffolds.
  secret    Manage cage-scoped secrets.
  watcher   Read the traffic watcher's findings and scan status.

Aliases:
  config → cage edit
  delete → cage destroy
  describe → cage show
  edit → cage edit
  exec → cage exec
  inspect → cage show
  logs → cage logs
  ls → cage list
  ps → cage list
  reload → cage restart
  restart → cage restart
  rm → cage destroy
  run → cage run
  shell → cage shell
  show → cage show
  start → cage start
  status → cage status
  stop → cage stop
  update → cage update
